Configure nested Tesseract and PaddleOCR settings in a multi-backend pipeline

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"text/plain","uri":"https://example.com/text/report.txt"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"ocr":{"enabled":false,"pipeline":{"quality_thresholds":{},"stages":[{"backend":"tesseract","priority":100,"tesseract_config":{"enable_table_detection":false,"psm":6}},{"backend":"paddleocr","paddle_ocr_settings":{"enable_table_detection":true,"model_tier":"server","use_angle_cls":true},"priority":90}]}}}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].mime_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].content);
}
```
